title: Common definitions
description: Shared building blocks for every Asclepius Orbit contract. Nothing here is a message by itself: other schemas $ref these definitions. Canonical units are fixed per channel type and never converted on reception: g (standard gravity), deg/s, mV, ohm, mm, cm, kg, Hz, ms, s.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the contract the message was produced against. Major must be 1 for this schema set.

astronaut_id.description: Pseudonymous crew identifier. Never a real name: this id travels over the MQTT bus.

device_id.description: Wearable or simulator identifier, unique per physical device.

stream_id.description: Identifier of one sensor stream inside a device. Declared in the session, repeated in every chunk and in the MQTT topic.

utc_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time. The UTC offset is mandatory, so naive timestamps are invalid; validators must have format checking enabled for date-time.

nrs.description: Numeric Rating Scale, integer 0 (none) to 10 (worst imaginable).

level.description: Traffic-light level. Final level is decided by the deterministic clinical rules, not by the model alone.

source.description: Where the data really comes from. device: real hardware, or real input typed by the astronaut. simulator: synthetic. replay: a recording played back. A demo mixing real and simulated data must say so; consumers must never hide it.

gravity_environment.description: Gravity the astronaut is exposed to while the data is recorded. Mandatory context: in microgravity an accelerometer does not see gravity, so Earth and space IMU data are not directly comparable.

muscle.description: Muscle under an EMG electrode pair.

spine_level.description: Vertebral level, lowercase so it can be embedded in ids (imu.l3.*).

placement.description: Where a sensor sits on the body. EMG needs muscle + side, IMU needs spine_level, stretch cord needs spine_region (and optionally the span it covers). The session schema enforces this per stream kind.

span.description: Vertebral span covered by a stretch cord.

quality.description: Signal quality for one channel of one chunk (or one feature). score: 0 unusable, 1 perfect. flags say why it is not 1. assessed_by tells who computed it; the engine may recompute and return its own.

feature_id.description: Dotted identifier of a derived metric. Must exist in the feature catalog (catalog/feature-catalog.json), after expanding its placeholders.

protocol_id.description: Standardised exercise or measurement protocol. The protocol is part of the comparison key: only data from the same protocol is comparable.
